subject: Re: Acceptance runway & security gating — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: alyssa.chen@mercurybank.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance runway & security gating — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to document the acceptance runway so your procurement and Infosec teams have a single place to track gating items before contract signature. High level:

- Redwood will provide the SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and a completed SIG/CAIQ workbook for your review by EOD Friday.
- We will share a DPA draft with Mercury's legal redline column; expect turnaround within 48 hours after you confirm the redline owner.
- Data retention: default retention for hosted API logs is 30 days; we outlined options for 90/365 day retention for audit material — pricing delta depends on retention and encryption-at-rest key management.

Action items (owner / target):
- Alyssa: confirm whether SOC 2 attestation + SIG/CAIQ are sufficient for the initial go/no-go (we can scope additional artifacts if needed) — target Thu 2027-04-08.
- Neha: send draft DPA and indicate preferred KMS options (Redwood KMS vs customer-managed) — target Fri 2027-04-09 (attached).
- Sean: lock commercial runway and update the MAP milestones in HubSpot (I'll tag the procurement owners).

I'll attach the SOC 2 and the initial SIG workbook (pre-populated). If you'd prefer a short sync instead of asynchronous review, we're available Thu morning PT.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2026_Redwood.pdf (pdf, 2.4MB), SIG-CAIQ_QA_Responses_Mercury.xlsx (xlsx, workbook)

From: alyssa.chen@mercurybank.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: j.patel@mercurybank.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance runway & security gating — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Lauren —

Thanks for the clear summary and the artifacts. Quick clarifications from Infosec:

1) SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II (covers at least last 6 months) and the control mapping to the SIG questions where relevant. The PDF you attached looks good but can you also provide an index that maps SOC controls to SIG/CAIQ rows?

2) SIG/CAIQ: our tooling requires the workbook in CSV export; can you include an export? Also, where you indicate 'data retention default 30 days', we need an explicit statement about what data is included (audit logs, request/response tokens, embeddings).

3) DPA: legal will look for explicit language on customer data deletion requests and subprocessor list. Can your legal team provide a redline-ready DPA (editable doc) by Friday? Procurement is flexible on timeline but legal needs the editable copy.

Procurement (cc Jitesh) will confirm commercial milestones after we see the DPA redline.

If you can get the mapping and CSV by EOD, we'll target an internal review Friday and aim for a procurement decision next Wednesday.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Sr. InfoSec Manager, MercuryBank
alyssa.chen@mercurybank.com

Quoted message below: (See Lauren's original)

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: alyssa.chen@mercurybank.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance runway & security gating — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Hi Alyssa / Lauren —

Uploading the CSV export of the SIG workbook and an index that maps SOC 2 sections to the SIG rows. See the two attachments. A few clarifications inline:

- What we classify as 'logs' for retention: request metadata (timestamps, client IPs, request IDs), service telemetry and error traces; plaintext request/response bodies and model-generated tokens are not retained by default in hosted API after 30 days for customers who do not opt-in to extended retention.
- For customers who require longer retention for audit we offer a 90/365-day retention tier; on the 365-day tier we recommend customer-managed KMS (HSM/KMS) — this appears in the pricing appendix of the MAP.
- DPA: attached the editable DPA (DPA_Mercury_Redlines_v1.docx) — it's a copy of our standard with a redline column for your comments.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I will circulate a one-page mapping doc that shows exactly which SIG questions are satisfied by the SOC report + our internal controls (target: Friday EOD).
- Marissa (legal) will review any redlines you propose and propose counter language.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ_QA_Responses_Mercury.csv, SOC2_SIG_index.xlsx, DPA_Mercury_Redlines_v1.docx

From: j.patel@mercurybank.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, alyssa.chen@mercurybank.com
Cc: procurement@mercurybank.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance runway & security gating — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Team —

Procurement is good to proceed with a commercial term sheet once Legal confirms the DPA redlines are consumable. Two quick asks:

1) Please confirm whether the 30-day retention option will impact the ability to perform forensic reviews in a post-incident scenario. We need assurance that audit artifacts can be exported in the event of an incident if the customer does not purchase extended retention.

2) Can Redwood accept a mutual indemnification carveout around regulated data types? Our legal will propose specific language — we'll add that to the DPA redline.

Proposed timeline: legal redline consensus by Friday (2027-04-16), term sheet executed by Monday (2027-04-19), go/no-go decision with vendor enablement target 2027-04-26. If Redwood needs a faster close we can compress procurement review if legal signs off earlier.

Regards,
Jitesh Patel
Head of Procurement, MercuryBank
j.patel@mercurybank.com

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: j.patel@mercurybank.com, alyssa.chen@mercurybank.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance runway & security gating — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Hi Jitesh / Alyssa —

Thanks — we reviewed the DPA redline you uploaded this morning. A few notes from Redwood legal to keep the timeline aligned with your targets:

- Data deletion / portability: we accept the proposed delete-on-request flow but ask to retain a narrow set of audit metadata for 90 days to support billing and fraud analysis (we propose language in the redline).
- Subprocessors: we'll provide an up-to-date subprocessors list and commit to 30-day notice for new subprocessors; for regulated subprocessors we'll offer a Security Review questionnaire prior to onboarding.
- Indemnity: Redwood can accept a mutual indemnity clause limited to gross negligence and will propose carveouts for third-party model behavior in the redline.

We will upload our marked DPA by EOD Thursday so Procurement has content to review on Friday. If Mercury can confirm the SOC/SIG mapping is acceptable by Friday, we can keep your proposed commercial timeline (term sheet next week, enablement by 04/26).

I'll drop a short doc into the HubSpot deal with the milestone dates and owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: DPA_Mercury_Redlines_v2.docx (redline)
